# Shubham Kumbhalkar

> Senior Software Engineer (SDE II) at Amazon with 10+ years building large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native platforms on AWS, and high-throughput backend services. Domain expertise in distributed systems, microservices, Java, Python, Rust, AWS, reliability/observability, and applied Generative AI.

## About
- Software Development Engineer II at Amazon; previously Senior Software Development Engineer at LendingClub (fintech / auto lending).
- Builds systems processing $48B+ in annual revenue at 99.99% uptime; engineered services handling 500K+ requests/sec across multiple external APIs.
- Core domains: distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS: Lambda, EKS, S3, CDK), microservices, high-throughput backend services, GenAI/NLP pipelines, reliability engineering, and fintech.
